native.observation: All60 actual military barricade capsules blocked the normal production Rapier courier capsule at each quality. No colliders removed. Fixture is explicit opening-war setup; not a playthrough.

camera.observation: Follow uses fixed polar54deg (36deg above ground). All5 authored mission cinematic offsets are[15,19,15], pitch41.85015deg. Same azimuth; production quaternion slerp between these poses bounds the orientation pitch by36..41.85015, with small presentation shake/roll. No top-down endpoint. The captured position-to-target angles are samples, not a substitute for quaternion orientation.

frames.observation: low hide tick13597 zoom1-5: oblique view with visible vertical sides, paving continuing under and beyond the camp. Wide view shows textured tan sandbags, dark-green tent walls, timber tables/pallet dressing and streets, with no black/unbuilt ground void. Close view preserves paving and props but much of scene is occupied by living crowd and corpses. High run is incomplete after a later bar/evaluate stall; this frame is only the actual hide phase.
